description.value: Sailor Hägar's is a neighbourhood brew pub in North Vancouver offering views of Vancouver Harbour and the city skyline, with a rotating selection of craft beers on tap alongside a full pub menu of burgers, wings, fish and chips, and more. The pub is known as one of the only spots on the North Shore staying open until 2am on weekends, and hosts regular karaoke nights, themed parties, live music, and sports viewing. An attached liquor store adds convenience for cyclists stocking up before a ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is accessible and confirms the pub's address (86 Semisch Ave, North Vancouver, BC V7M 3H8), phone (604.984.3087), and active operation as a full-service pub with rotating craft beers, a food menu, and regular events. No bike-specific amenities (rack, parking, pump, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags. Two anomalies are flagged: the /contact-us/ page embeds a Pitt Meadows address (19167 Ford Road, V3Y 2B6) that belongs to the web design firm, and the /category/event/ page contains copy-pasted content from a different venue called 'The Jolly Coachman.'
concerns: The /contact-us/ page embeds the address '19167 Ford Road, Pitt Meadows, BC V3Y 2B6', which appears to be the web design firm's (Stigan Media Inc) address inserted as a template artifact — not the pub's location.

The /category/event/ page contains verbatim content about a different venue called 'The Jolly Coachman', indicating copy-pasted website template content not original to Sailor Hägar's. This raises minor credibility concerns about the website's accuracy.
Daily specials are explicitly 'DINE IN ONLY, NO TAKEOUT' per the menu page — noteworthy for cyclists wanting to grab food to go, though this restriction may apply only to specials.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operating neighbourhood pub and liquor store in North Vancouver with a full food menu and confirmed recent OSM check (2026-01-21); a practical meal and refreshment stop for touring cyclists on the North Shore.

wow_evidence: one of the only spots on the North Shore staying open until 2am on weekends
